lines: Me
Alright, we're going! We're counting on you, Clear!!
We let Clear take care of the approaching flock of scarecrows and left from the opposite door.
As Clear had said, the door opened to a path that led further into the castle.
Me
(But, this is...)
On both sides there were statues of mythological beasts and goddesses aligned.
Just as any other room in the castle, this corridor also had an extravagantly luxurious atmosphere.
Hebiko
If Hebiko recalls... Clear-chan told us to turn right at the end of this corridor, didn't she?
Shikanosuke
Hey, Fuma!? Let's go fast before those scarecrows get here!!
Those two started running toward the end of the corridor. But as for meー
Me
Wait... I remember now!! Hold up, you two!
Hebiko and Shikanosuke
Ehh??
Hebiko and Shikanosuke
Remember what?
Me
About that butler. I remembered after seeing this demon dog statue.
I pointed my finger at the statue that stood right in front of me as Hebiko and Shikanosuke turned my way.
It was a monster dog with three headsーa statue of the watchdog of the "Netherworld": Cerberus.
Me
That's it, the "Netherworld"!!! That old man used a Ninja Art to link this world to the Netherworldー He's a "Netherworld Jutsu" user!
Shikanosuke
Huh? Netherworld... Jutsu...?
Shikanosuke made a face like he had never heard of it.
Well, that was only natural. It was such a rare Ninja Art that nobody had seen it for at least several decades.
Me
It was in an old book in Gosha. A Ninja Art that allows you to become immortal and turn into a spiritual entityー
Me
Apparently, you get fixed in a certain place, and in exchange for that, you can be an immortal and invincible undead as long as you stay there.
Hebiko
F-Fixed in a certain place...? Maybe like a ghost bound to a specific place to haunt?
Me
Well, something like that.
In other words...
I didn't know how long had passed since then, but a Taimanin had used Netherworld Jutsu in this castle.
Me
...That jutsu user probably was the butler of the Mizuki Family.
By using this castle as the "place" to fix his body, the butler became a ghost and kept protecting the Mizuki Family and Yukikaze for eternity...
Shikanosuke
I-I-I-Invincible!? We're being chased by someone that dangerous!!?
Me
Yeah. As long as we're in this castle, nobody will be able to defeat that old man.
With this I finally understood what Asagi-sensei had meant before.
She said "Yukikaze is living alone" because the user of Netherworld Jutsu was already dead.
However, the invincible ghost butler was protecting the castle so "Clear is safe"...
Me
This is out of our hands. We need to ask Yukikaze to stop him.
Hebiko
Right. Let's hurry up then! We're almost at Yukikaze-chan's room.
Shikanosuke
Yeah!! Let's go, you two!
Then...
Shikanosuke
Wooow!! What is this place!?
Hebiko
It looks like a room fit for a king....
Me
For real. How rich is she exactly...
We followed Clear's instructions and arrived at a very large space that looked like an audience hall.
Me
Anyway, it feels like we're one step away from our goal.
Exactly as Clear had told us, we could see a door at the end of the hall.
That must have been Yukikaze's room...
Butler of the Netherworld
『ーOhohohoh! I was waiting for you, boy!!』
Me
Hgh!? Of course it's him...
Shikanosuke
Aiiiieeee!! He's coming heeeere!?
As we could have expected, he wasn't going to let us escape that easily.
Along with the voice resonating throughout the hall, a dark smoke arose from the floor and soon took form.
It was the user of "Netherworld Jutsu" protecting the Mizuki castleーthe butler of the Netherworld.
Butler of the Netherworld
『Fuma, you insolent little rat!! I knew it, I knew you would come to this place!』
Me
So you got here before us? I thought you were going senile but you seem surprisingly sharp, old man.
Butler of the Netherworld
『Of course!!! I cannot let my guard down against someone as crafty as you, Fuma!!』
Me
Mwahaha, I'm honored to be appraised so highly by a user of such a rare Ninja Art as "Netherworld Jutsu".
I let a grin spread across my face, to which the ghost butler seemed to make a surprised expression.
Butler of the Netherworld
『Oh? As I should expect from the son of Danjo. It has been some time since I met someone who knew of my Ninja Art.』
Me
Yeah. I know that you're immortal and invincible inside this castle. That's why...
Me
...I have no intention of fighting you. Please go and ask Yukikaze in that room back there. We're her friends.
It was our last attempt to persuade him right in front of our destination.
However, the result was the same.
Butler of the Netherworld
『A waste of breath!!! Fuma, you villain, I will destroy you with my jutsu for the wrongs you've committed against Miss Yukikaze!!』
Me
Haha. Well, saw that one coming.
There was no way this strongly opinionated old man would listen seriously to anything I had to say.
As the butler of the Netherworld yelled, the furniture and decorations around us began to dance in the air again.
Shikanosuke
Woaahh!? That fancy furniture is gonna rain on us agaiiiiiiiiiin!!!
Hebiko
Wh-What should we do, Fuma-chan!?
Me
We can't exactly fight head-on with that invincible ghost geezer...
Me
I'll give you the orders!! We'll break through and rush to Yukikaze's room!!
